requests_definition: Actual synthetic arrivals on each planning day; their recorded beds are ignored.
census_definition: In-service beds held by patients with admission_date < day < discharge_date. Beds in maintenance in the inventory snapshot are treated as out of service on every day.
baseline_policy: Arrival-order first fit into the home ward, no off-service placement, same reserve and staffing rules as the optimizer.

constraints.staffing: reported (staffing_exceedances); hard only in the rostered_staffing_hard sensitivity variant

reason_definitions.no_compatible_bed_in_inventory: No in-service bed matches the request's bed type, isolation, and ward rules (for the baseline: no such bed in the home ward).
reason_definitions.all_compatible_beds_occupied: Compatible beds exist but every one was occupied at the start of the day.
reason_definitions.staffing_limit: Free compatible beds exist only in wards already at rostered nurse capacity (only when staffing is a hard constraint).
reason_definitions.protected_reserve: The only free compatible beds are the protected ICU/emergency reserve, which is held for critical-severity requests.
reason_definitions.taken_by_other_requests: Free compatible beds existed but were all assigned to other requests the same day.

limitations: Arrivals are batched per day; intra-day timing is not modeled.
Isolation labels are synthetic scenario probabilities, not clinical flags.
Bed maintenance status is only known for the snapshot date.
The synthetic shift roster is not tied to ward census, so rostered staffing is reported rather than enforced.
